name: blueprint
summary: Technical drawing on blue paper. Fits hardware, engineering, robotics, specifications and research breakthroughs, especially when the source image shows a device, machine, diagram or schematic. Not for people-centred stories.
prompt: Technical blueprint drawing: fine white and pale cyan linework on deep blue paper, cutaway views, dimension lines and callout leader lines with no readable labels, drafting-table precision, with the given palette's warm colour only as a small accent.
